title: Phase 70 publishes empty observation-review and series-admission dockets
summary: Thirty-two observation-review dockets, thirty-two revision-lineage registers, and eight series-admission dockets now expose the human decision path after Phase 69 intake. All submission, review, receipt, revision, observation, and series fields remain empty.
evidence_note: This release contains empty review and admission workflow contracts plus synthetic-only validation. It does not contain a submitted observation, source attempt, access result, review, decision, receipt, revision event, accepted value, actual break, series point, cohort admission, comparison, causal claim, or outcome.
publication_effect: Adds two Published briefings, one Published dependency map, one searchable registry with forty detail routes, one public export, and reader-surface integrations while leaving all evidence and outcome states unchanged.
